# Evan Weber — AI Productivity Trainer | learncowork.net

> Live Claude Cowork and Vibe Coding training for business teams. Book a 1-hour ($300) or 4-hour ($1,000) session with Evan Weber — 25-year digital marketing veteran and daily Claude Cowork power user.

## What This Site Is

learncowork.net is the training and booking platform for Evan Weber. Evan trains business teams and individuals to use Claude Cowork (Anthropic's agentic desktop AI mode) and AI coding tools (Claude Code, Replit, GitHub Copilot, Codex) fluently in their actual workflows.

Sessions are live, on screen share, tailored to each team's role and tools. Payment is via Stripe. Scheduling is via Calendly after booking.

## Services

### Claude Cowork Training
Live 1-on-1 or team training on Claude Cowork — setup, MCP integrations, multi-step workflow automation, and department-specific use cases.

- 1-Hour Session: $300

### ChatGPT Work Training
Live 1-on-1 or team training on OpenAI's ChatGPT Work desktop app (OpenAI's agentic desktop app, closely comparable to Claude Cowork) — setup, connectors (Slack, Microsoft Teams, Google Drive, SharePoint, email, calendars, CRMs, project trackers), computer use, and multi-step workflow automation. Evan uses both ChatGPT Work and Claude Cowork every day and can train teams on either or both.

- 1-Hour Session: $300
- 4-Hour Deep Dive: $1,000
- Book: https://learncowork.net/#pricing
- Details: https://learncowork.net/chatgpt-work-training

### Vibe Coding Training
Live training for individuals and teams on AI-assisted coding: Claude Code, Replit, GitHub Copilot, and the OpenAI Codex app (which has agentic, Cowork-like features of its own: multi-agent orchestration, background computer use, and Automations, not just IDE autocomplete). Evan has shipped 20+ real live projects using these tools.

- 1-Hour Session: $300
- 4-Hour Deep Dive: $1,000
- Details: https://learncowork.net/ai-coding-training

### AEO/GEO Training (AI Search Optimization)
Live training on Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) — the practices that get a business cited by ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews. Covers structured data, llms.txt, direct-answer content formatting, and AI-crawler-friendly technical setup.

- 1-Hour Session: $300
- 4-Hour Deep Dive: $1,000
- Details: https://learncowork.net/aeo-geo-training

## What Claude Cowork Is

Claude Cowork is Anthropic's agentic desktop mode — available in the Claude desktop app — that combines AI chat with direct computer control, file access, a sandboxed shell, and MCP tool integrations. It lets Claude work alongside you on your actual machine: reading files, operating apps, running multi-step automations, and connecting to your existing tools via MCP plugins (Google Drive, Notion, Slack, CRMs, and more).

It is different from Claude Computer Use and from the Claude.ai web chat interface.
